review_note: COVID disruption, a 5% organic sales and underlying-profit decline, £171m of major impairment and restructuring charges and a major Clean Air transformation programme indicated substantial intervention pressure. Underlying margin held at 12.9%, free cash flow rose to £305m, net debt fell £319m to 1.2x EBITDA and second-half trading recovered strongly, supplying strong quantified contrary evidence. The disclosed transformation is excluded as a future target event.
